comparisons.peer_summary: In 2023, the company issued $6.70 billion of senior unsecured notes and term loans, receiving $6.69 billion in cash, and prepaid $600 million of the 2024 Term Loan A principal.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and MU disclose significant term loan borrowings undertaken in 2023 to fund corporate activities. AVGO entered into three unsecured term loans totaling $30,390 million (Term A-2, A-3, and A-5) in connection with the VMware Merger, citing the '2023 Credit Agreement'. Similarly, MU issued $6.70 billion of senior unsecured notes and term loan agreements in 2023, receiving $6.69 billion in cash. While AVGO's loans were structured as a multi-tranche term loan facility for an acquisition, MU's issuance included term loans that were partially used to prepay existing 2024 Term Loan A principal.

sentences.text: Upon completion of the VMware Merger, we entered an $11,195 million unsecured term A-2 facility (the "Term A-2 Loan"), an $11,195 million unsecured term A-3 facility (the "Term A-3 Loan"), and an $8,000 million unsecured term A-5 facility (the "Term A-5 Loan", collectively, the "2023 Term Loans").
In 2023, we issued $6.70 billion of senior unsecured notes and term loan agreements and received cash of $6.69 billion.
